content: Yesu ꞌina toholo hila
Coinega wete gona ꞌiꞌadaleya, beno wiki ꞌana sabwelo nugenugetana gonagona, ma wahiwahineyedi holowa siꞌatububuya siꞌeweya, ma sitauyeyama gogowa.
Sitauyama ma gogo siꞌiteya ꞌana ꞌahuboda dimwa sibui hile pwaiya.
Coinega galihina ꞌalona siluhuwa, ma Yesu wahina geya siꞌitatoho.
Coinega gogoina ꞌoina maꞌidi henuwanaluwa simiyamiya ma siꞌeꞌebubuna, ma tuta ꞌiꞌiuna ꞌoina loheya ꞌeluwa, ma ꞌadi ꞌwama waꞌewaꞌeꞌena ta ꞌasiꞌasilalana silatuwa, ta deidiya sitoholowa.

Wahiwahine loheyaedi siꞌitediya ta simatauta, ꞌoinega sibeꞌu talutalubuꞌiya baleꞌuwa, ma loheloheyaedi wahiwahine ꞌoidiya sigwaeya, “Toꞌaha weyahina toꞌamasa ꞌidi tupwa ma loheya mayawasina waꞌebeꞌebese?
Tauna geya ꞌebwa, ta ꞌina gwaeina ꞌoimiya wanuwatuhuyahi mwalo Galili ꞌoina baꞌidamiu wamiyamiya, tutaina ꞌigwaeya,
‘Taugu Loheyaiguina nata siheꞌebwayaegau togala ꞌoidiya, kelose ꞌoina situtu hepaꞌiyegau, ma sabwelo hetoina ꞌoina ꞌamasega nata yatoholo hila’.”
Wahiwahineyedi gwae bewa sinuwatuhu yahiya,
ꞌoinega galihina siꞌebesineya sitauya Yesu ꞌina topaihowao site lebeni ma ꞌiyadiyao ꞌoidiya, ta sihepwaila toꞌaha gide gogowa ꞌoidiya ꞌilatuwa.
Tohepwailaedi taudi Meli Magidala ta Yowana ta hali Meli, tauna Yemesa sinana, ma wete tupwadi wahiwahine baꞌidadiyao, Yesu ꞌina toholo hila weyahina ꞌina topaihowaowedi sihegwaediya,
ma tomotaedi wahiwahine ꞌidi gwae geya sihemisae, ꞌidi nuwatuhu ꞌabehega tuwa silolotuyena.
Ma hesi Pita ꞌitoholowa, ꞌipili gogoina ꞌoina, ꞌiꞌitaluhuwa ꞌaleꞌomo, ꞌoinega ꞌihila maꞌina nuwapwanopwano toꞌaha ꞌilatuwa.
Tomota siteluwa ꞌidi helobaloba Yesu baꞌidadiu

Sabweloina ꞌoina Yesu ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌeluwa sitautauya ꞌaigeda ꞌasa ꞌoina sanina Emeusa. Casaina ꞌana dudula Yelusalema ꞌoinega gide ꞌeguma gonegonega tatoholo ma gonagonaina ꞌana gamwagamwana ꞌoina talatu.
Siteluwaedi sitautauya ma sihehegwaegwae ginauledi Yesu ꞌoina silatuwa weyahidi,
Sitautauya sigwaegwae liya, ꞌoinega Yesu ꞌoidiya ꞌilatuwa ta baꞌidadiu sitautauya.
Yesuina siꞌita pwaiya, ma hesi gesowana siꞌinana.
Coinega ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “To nuwatuhu weyahina wahegwaegwae liya?” Ma taudi maꞌidi nuwagala sitoholo henonowa.
Ma ꞌiyanaina sanina Kaliopasa ꞌigwae hila, ta Yesu ꞌoina ꞌigwaeya, “Ciya, ꞌowa ꞌuboimo Yelusalema ꞌoina geya ꞌusanapu toꞌaha ꞌilatuwa sabwelo ꞌetoi ꞌoidiya wa?”

Coinega Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Toꞌaha?” Ma taudi sigwaeya, “Nuwatuhuwedi Yesu gwama Nasaleta ꞌoina silatuwa. Loheyaina tauna palopita, ma wete Yehoba ma tomota matadiya ꞌina gwaeyao ta ꞌina paihowao waiwaidi.
Ma ꞌima Topwaoli Madoudi ma ꞌima tohanugetao loheyaina siyatalaeya ꞌina ꞌamasa weyahina, ta muliyetega toloꞌalehao situtu hepaꞌiyeya kelose ꞌoina.
Ma ꞌahemiseya ꞌabehega ꞌida ꞌabihetemai tauma meIsileli. Siloheꞌamasiya ma sabwelo ꞌeluwa sigumwala, ma nige sabwelo hetoina.
Ma tupwana wahiwahine ꞌoimega nuwama siꞌabiheꞌwaniya weyahina nige ꞌabwa kululu sitauya galiha,
ta Yesuina wahina geya siꞌitatoho, ma sihilama, ta toꞌaha gide anelose ꞌidi heꞌita ꞌoidiya beno ꞌoima sihepwaila ꞌabehega ꞌitoholo hila pwaiya.
Wete gide tupwadi ꞌoimega sitauya galihina ꞌoina, ta silobeya gide wahiwahineyedi ꞌidi hepwaila, ta Yesuina geya siꞌitatoho.”
Coinega Yesu ꞌoidiya ꞌigwaeya, “Nuwapotapotaimi, weyahina geya palopitao nugenugetadi ꞌidi gwaeyao wada hemisediya.
Toꞌabihetenaina ꞌilobwaine bwaibwainiya ma muyamuyaedi ꞌida lobadi ma ꞌoinega muliyetega sanina ꞌihemadou.”

Coinega ꞌihegaina ma ꞌoidiya ꞌilihasa toꞌaha gide Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌina hepwaila Toꞌabihetenaina weyahina. Mosese ta palopitao ꞌidi bukiyao ꞌoidiyega ꞌihegaina, ma Buki Heꞌasisi mabwaiyana ꞌilohegumwalidiya, ta ꞌoinega sanapu sida loba.
Ma tupwaina ꞌoina sitautauya deina silatu pwaiya, ta Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Wamiyamiya ma yatautauya.”
Ma taudi sigwaeya, “Geya! Sahena ꞌutautauya, ꞌebwa taꞌeno, weyahina ꞌiboi pwaiya.” Coinega ꞌitagwala, ma ꞌiluhuwa ꞌidi hada.
Cidi tuta ꞌai ꞌoina, Yesu beledi ꞌiꞌeweya, ta weyahina ꞌigwae helauwa, ma muliyetega ꞌiꞌabihisiya ta ꞌiꞌebwaediya.
Nage ꞌoina nuwadi ꞌisabwalena ta Yesuina siꞌinaneya, ta ꞌoidiyega ꞌiꞌwaiha.
Ta siteluwaedi taudi ꞌoidiya sigwaegwae, sigwaeya, “Moisa tutenina ꞌedai tanaonaoma, ma ꞌilihalihasa Buki weyahina, ꞌada lotohona hagana gide tuwa ꞌaiwe ꞌateda ꞌisabesabelulu.”
Coinega sitoholo mwayamwayauwa ma sitauya Yelusalema, ta nobwa ꞌiyadiyao site lebeni silobediya, ma tupwadi wete baꞌidadiyao simiya ꞌautama,
ma bodaedi Yesu weyahina sigwaegwae, sigwaeya, “Saimoni ꞌida Badaina ꞌiꞌita pwaiya, ꞌamasega ꞌitoholo hila.”
Ta siteluwaedi wete siheꞌoteꞌotetela toꞌaha gide ꞌedai ꞌilatuwa, ma wete ꞌina ꞌabihisi beledi ꞌoinega siꞌinaneya, siteteliya.
Yesu ꞌilatuwa ꞌana tomuliyao ꞌoidiya
Cabwa ꞌiyadiyao ꞌoidiya siheꞌoteꞌotetela ma Yesuina ꞌilatuwa ta gamwagamwanidiya ꞌitoholowa, ꞌigwaeya, “Helau ꞌoimiya,”
ta siꞌiteya ma simatauta, ꞌidi nuwatuhu ꞌaigeda yaluyaluwa galana.
Coinega Yesu ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Sahena wamatamatauta! Sahena wete wahehenuwanaluwa. Taugu tuwa.
Ma hesi nimagu ta ꞌahegu waꞌitadi ma waꞌabitohogau, weyahina yaluyaluwa galana geya ꞌwapinamo, ta wete geya lulunamo.”
Gide ꞌihegwaeya, ma wete nimana ta ꞌahena ꞌiheꞌitaediya ꞌoidiya.
Nage ꞌoina siyaliyaya, ma hesi tupwana maꞌidi henuwanaluwa weyahina geya sihemisa moisa. Ma ꞌihegwaediya, “Ceꞌahai hisa, waꞌebwaegau ma yaꞌai?”
Ma silahana tupwana mwesomwesona siꞌebwaeya,
ma matadiya ꞌiꞌaiya.

Ma ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwaeya, “Gwaeyedi yatetela pwaidiya ꞌoimiya tutaina taugu baꞌidamiu, mabwaiyana weyahigu sileleya Mosese ꞌina Buki ꞌoina ta palopitao ꞌidi buki ꞌoidiya ma wete buki wali Same ꞌoidiya, ma ꞌoinega ꞌigu hepwailaina ꞌana sanapu moisa ꞌida latu.”
Nage ꞌoina nuwadi ꞌiꞌabihe ꞌasilalediya ta Buki Heꞌasisi sisanapuya.
Ma ꞌoidiya ꞌigwaeya, “Bewa gide silele ꞌesediya ꞌigwae, ‘Toꞌabihetenaina muyamuya ta ꞌamasa ꞌida loba, ma sabwelo hetoina ꞌoina ꞌamasega ꞌida toholo hila,
ma muliyetega saninega tetela bwebweꞌana, nuwabui ma galana ꞌana nuwasam weyahidi siguguyae.’ Cidi guguyaina ꞌida hegaina Yelusalema ꞌoinega, ma ꞌida sakowasi baleꞌu mabwaiyana ꞌoina.
Ginaula bewa ꞌomi tuwa ꞌadi tohepwailao.
Ma hesi taugu nata Tamagu ꞌina gwae hemisaina, beno Yaluyaluwana yahesumaneyama ꞌoimiya ma ꞌiꞌabihe waiwaiyegomi, ꞌoinega Yelusalema ꞌoina wayamwayamwa weyahina.”
Yesu ꞌina hane galewa
Coinega ꞌina gwae ꞌilosalohiya, ma muliyetega ꞌitoediya ma sitauya Bedani ꞌoina, ta nobwa nimana ꞌiyasidiya ꞌoidiya, ma ꞌigwae helauwediya.
Cina gwae helauina ꞌoina, ꞌaena ꞌiꞌeweya ma ꞌihaneya galewa.
Taudi ꞌina ꞌebehaneina ꞌoina maꞌidi heꞌasisi siꞌetuluha, ma muliyetega maꞌidi yaliyaya madouna sihila Yelusalema.
Sihila ma Hada Heꞌasisi ꞌalona tuta baibaiwana Yehoba sihehepwatuwe.
